name: Night Mansions
description: Unlike other regions, the Kemets of Storm Islands have a singular urban concentration known as Night Mansions. In a valley surrounded by walls of ice, mists, and frost, a vast assemblage of palaces and grand mansions lies. Every architectural detail meticulously emphasizes death, adorned with skulls, bones, and numerous sharp and macabre ornaments. The skeletons and zombies handle the hard work, allowing the citizens to devote themselves to Bás and train in combat, ice elementalism, and necromancy. Entire families, including extended relatives, commonly inhabit these mansions, attended to by undead servants. During the Midnight Sun, many events take place throughout the city. Magical musical instruments play, undead battle in the Arena of the Undead, and numerous other festivities occur. A law of the city dictates that no one may attack another within its boundaries. Offenders face severe punishment, typically lashing by ice whips. The cumulative slashes deal a total of 5d6 damage, and the wounded creature cannot regain hit points until finishing a long rest. When foreigners visit the city, some kemets provoke them solely to relish the spectacle of their punishment.
